text:
Nadia: Willow.ai just asked if we can run a short POC for their Willow-Blend-7B variant. Main asks: custom SentencePiece tokenizer, 4-bit quant with fallback, embeddings for reranker (different vector dims), KMS + SAML, and committed-per-call pricing for a 4-week eval.
Ethan: Quick catalog check 1 our registry has blend-7b-v1 but only with the stock spm. Need their tokenizer.model file and vocab to validate token-to-id mapping. If their piece size differs we can remap but want to inspect.
Sophie: On embeddings: they want 1536-d vectors but our blend embeddings return 1024 by default. We can run a finetuned head or return raw hidden-state pooled vectors; need to confirm accuracy tradeoffs. Ask them which reranker they intend to use (dot vs cosine) and if they need normalization.
Liam: Security ops: KMS + SAML SSO ok; for private pilot they want VPC peering. We'll need their AWS account ID and key policy. Also check legal: they filled part of the security QS but left data retention blank.
Nadia: I'll ask for tokenizer.model, a 200-line sample corpus, expected RPS, and desired embedding dim. Also ask whether user data may include PHI.
Ethan: Perf note: 4-bit path works but expect p95 inflation at long contexts. I'll run a short perf with batch=4, seq=1536 and compare to fp16.
Ethan: ```bash
# perf run
redwood perf --model blend-7b-v1 --quant 4bit --batch 4 --seq 1536 --trace
# snippet
# p50 64ms/token
# p95 285ms/token
```
Ethan: Uploaded results to ticket RW-19921. If embedding head is added, embedding compute will add ~12-18% to per-call latency.
Sophie: For embedding dims: option A) run a small adapter head to project 1024->1536 (cheap) but may need eval; option B) ask them to accept 1024 and retrain their reranker. Recommend option A for POC. I'll prep a tiny adapter example.
Liam: On pricing: hosted per-token ~ $0.011/1k gen tokens; embedding calls priced per-vector; if they want committed-per-call we can structure a 4-week commitment with minimums and burst credits. Need expected weekly token burn to quote.
Nadia: They just replied with tokenizer.model and said expected peak RPS 6, avg 1.5. Also they want log retention 180 days for analytics.
Liam: 180 days means enterprise addendum + SLA adjustment. Will surface to legal. Also KMS cross-account requires their key policy; send them the template.
Ethan: Based on RPS, recommended path: small dedicated pool (1-2 GPUs) for stable latency; enable prefix caching for chat sessions. I'll add fallback to fp16 if p95 > 300ms for >5m window.
Sophie: I'll prepare adapter code snippet and a quick eval harness to test embedding similarity after projection. Will include sample metrics to show hit-rate impact.
redwood-salesbot: Ticket RW-19921 created and assigned to #sales, #eng-ml, #eng-security.
Nadia: Proposed POC plan to Willow: week 0 collect artifacts + security QS; week 1 tokenization + embed validation; week 2 perf + pricing options; week 3 integration + ops runbook; week 4 decision + optional private trial. Sending now.
Ethan: I'll run a short perf on their tokenizer once they confirm token IDs (ETA EOD).
Liam: I'll draft a 3-option pricing sheet: hosted PAYG, 4-week committed pool, private deployment estimate with addendum.
Sophie: Adding a note: if their reranker expects normalized vectors we should normalize on our side to reduce integration work. Will add to docs.
Nadia: Thanks team, will update after they accept the POC plan :thumbsup:
